description:
The cash rate target over time, oldest first. `decisions` lists every
change with its size in basis points; `monthly` gives one value per month,
for charts and joins against other monthly series.

**Price: 1¢ per call.**

frequency.description: `decisions` — one row per change since 1990 — or `monthly` — the monthly average target since 1990.

to.description: End of range (inclusive), same formats as `from`.
